verdict.rationale: Rive's runtimes are documented and confirmed on GitHub as open-source libraries (rive-docs-21, rive-gh-1, rive-gh-2), giving AI-native users real source access to the rendering/runtime layer, but community evidence notes the MIT license only covers a 'rendering abstraction layer, a subset of the Rive runtime' while the Editor itself (where files are authored) remains closed-source (rive-comm-5, rive-comm-1). missing for 10: full-product open license (editor/design tool source not published), independent confirmation of license file/terms, clarity on what runtime components are excluded from the OSS layer.
